description: Swimlane configuration stored on a container node.

members.name: CellLabels
members.description: Labels for each cell indexed by row*ColumnCount+column.

members.name: ColumnCount
members.description: Number of columns in the swimlane grid.

members.name: ColumnSizes
members.description: Width of each column. If empty, columns share equal width.

members.name: HeaderSize
members.description: Size of the header area perpendicular to the lane direction (row header width or column header height).

members.name: IsHorizontal
members.description: True for horizontal lanes (rows), false for vertical lanes (columns).

members.name: RowCount
members.description: Number of rows in the swimlane grid.

members.name: RowSizes
members.description: Height of each row. If empty, rows share equal height.
